_comment: Documents the CLI's actual, hardcoded confinement — this file is not read by the code (agent-control/lib/workspace.mjs computes ROOT from its own install location, so it can't be misconfigured to point somewhere else). Kept here for a human to see the boundary without reading source.
workspaceRoot: the parent directory of agent-control/ (i.e. rivatest-main/)
httpServer: none — CLI only in this phase, see docs/RIVA_SECURITY.md
